headline: European study examines whether air pollution affects the benefits of walking in COPD
dek: The European Lung Foundation has highlighted a new European study asking whether air pollution changes the benefits of walking for people with COPD.
body:
The European Lung Foundation (ELF) has highlighted a new European study that examines whether air pollution affects the benefits of walking for people with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).

In a post on X, ELF said that many people with COPD are encouraged to stay active, and asked whether air pollution affects the benefits of walking. According to the post, the study "set out to answer this question".

The post did not describe the study's design, participants or findings, and it did not name the journal in which the work was published. ELF directed readers to a research summary, linked in the post, for further information.

ELF describes itself as dedicated to lung health throughout Europe, providing patient information and raising awareness about lung conditions. The post carried the hashtags #COPD, #LungHealth, #PhysicalActivity and #Research.
key_quote: Many people with COPD are encouraged to stay active, but does air pollution affect the benefits of walking?
